passages.page: 第6页 · 阅读理解 B（68—71题）

sentences.sentence: Zoe Chambers was a successful PR (Public Relations) consultant and life was going well — she had a great job, a beautiful flat and a busy social life in London.
sentences.main: Zoe Chambers was a successful PR consultant; life was going well; she had a great job, a flat and a busy social life.
sentences.analysis: 先看第一分句：Zoe Chambers 是主语，was 是系动词，a successful ... consultant 是表语。and 连接另一分句 life was going well；破折号后 she had ... 进一步解释生活顺利的表现，两个分句的主语不同，不能把所有 was/had 统称为 Zoe 的并列谓语。
sentences.meaning: 佐伊·钱伯斯是一位成功的公关顾问，生活十分顺利——她在伦敦有一份好工作、一套漂亮的公寓，还拥有忙碌的社交生活。
distractors: 佐伊原是一位不成功的公关顾问，伦敦生活非常困难。
佐伊虽然有漂亮的公寓，但从未在伦敦工作。
佐伊在伦敦当公关顾问时已经厌倦社交和工作。
deepNotes: 先看第一分句：Zoe Chambers 是主语，was 是系动词，a successful ... consultant 是表语。and 连接另一分句 life was going well；破折号后 she had ... 进一步解释生活顺利的表现，两个分句的主语不同，不能把所有 was/had 统称为 Zoe 的并列谓语。

roleExplanations.s: Zoe Chambers 是首个主句的主语；life 和 she 分别是后续独立分句的主语。
roleExplanations.v: was 表示 Zoe 当时的身份。life was going well 和 she had ... 各有自己的主语、谓语，不是共享主语的并列谓语。
roleExplanations.p: a successful PR (Public Relations) consultant 是系动词 was 后的表语，说明 Zoe 的职业，不是动词宾语。

grammarSupplements.text: life was going well
grammarSupplements.explanation: and 后的主语是 life，谓语 was going，表达她过得顺利。

grammarSupplements.text: she had a great job, a beautiful flat and a busy social life in London.
grammarSupplements.explanation: she had ... 补充说明先前的 life was going well。

studyUnits.question: was 后面哪一部分说明 Zoe 的身份？
studyUnits.explanation: a successful PR consultant 是 Zoe Chambers 的表语，不能把这一部分误当宾语。

studyUnits.question: 哪一个词修饰 consultant，说明 Zoe 的工作做得好？
studyUnits.explanation: successful 修饰 consultant，意思是成功的公关顾问。

studyUnits.question: and 后的独立分句以什么为主语？
studyUnits.explanation: life 是第二个分句的主语，指她的生活。

studyUnits.question: life 后面的谓语是哪一组词？
studyUnits.explanation: was going 是过去进行时，表达生活当时进展顺利。

studyUnits.question: 哪个词说明生活过得怎么样？
studyUnits.explanation: well 修饰 was going，表示过得顺利。

studyUnits.question: 破折号后的新分句以谁为主语？
studyUnits.explanation: she 指 Zoe；这个分句在具体解释前一句的生活为什么顺利。

studyUnits.question: 这个新分句的谓语是哪个词？
studyUnits.explanation: had 表示拥有，不是前面 was 的并列谓语。

studyUnits.question: 她拥有的三样东西是哪一段？
studyUnits.text: a great job, a beautiful flat and a busy social life
studyUnits.explanation: 这三项是 had 的并列宾语：工作、公寓、社交生活。

studyUnits.question: 哪个词修饰 flat，说明公寓的特点？
studyUnits.explanation: beautiful 修饰 flat，说明漂亮的公寓。

studyUnits.question: 哪个词修饰 social life，说明社交生活的状态？
studyUnits.explanation: busy 修饰 social life，说明她当时社交活动丰富。

studyUnits.question: 哪一部分交代这些工作和生活是在什么城市？
studyUnits.explanation: in London 交代她当时居住与活动的地点，不是要求单独判定介词类别。

sentences.sentence: Then one evening in June last year, she received a text message telling her she was out of work.

targets.o: a text message

sentences.main: she received
sentences.analysis: 主干 she received a text message。telling her she was out of work 是现在分词后置修饰 message，表示短信传达的内容；she was out of work 是 telling 的内容从句，不是 received 的另一个宾语。不要单独圈介词短语。
sentences.meaning: 接着，去年六月的一个晚上，她收到一条短信，通知她失业了。
distractors: 去年六月，她通过一条短信获得了一份新工作。
她写短信给别人，告诉对方自己正在寻找工作。
她因为收到私人短信，决定辞去公关顾问的工作。
deepNotes: 主干 she received a text message。telling her she was out of work 是现在分词后置修饰 message，表示短信传达的内容；she was out of work 是 telling 的内容从句，不是 received 的另一个宾语。不要单独圈介词短语。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语是「she」。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「received」。
roleExplanations.o: a text message 是 received 的宾语；也认可把后面修饰 message 的 telling... 一并选为完整宾语名词短语。

grammarSupplements.text: telling her she was out of work.
grammarSupplements.explanation: 修饰宾语 message，解释短信说了什么。

grammarSupplements.text: she was out of work.
grammarSupplements.explanation: 省略了 that，是 telling 后说明具体消息的从句，意思是她失业了。

o: a text message telling her she was out of work.

studyUnits.question: 收到短信的时间是哪一段？
studyUnits.text: Then one evening in June last year,
studyUnits.explanation: 交代去年六月某晚的时间背景，修饰 received。

studyUnits.question: 哪一部分补充说明短信传达了什么？
studyUnits.text: telling her she was out of work.
studyUnits.explanation: 修饰宾语 a text message；这是短信通知她失业的内容。

studyUnits.question: 短信告诉她发生了什么事？
studyUnits.explanation: 这是 telling her 后省略 that 的内容从句，意思是她失业了。

sentences.sentence: "The first two weeks were the most difficult to live through," she said.

targets.o: "The first two weeks were the most difficult to live through,"

sentences.main: she said: "The first two weeks were the most difficult to live through."
sentences.analysis: 说话框架是 she said，前面的完整直接引语是 said 所表达的内容；引语内部 The first two weeks 是主语，were 是系动词，the most difficult to live through 是表语。注意题目让你找外层引述框架。
sentences.meaning: 她说：“最初的两个星期最难熬。”
distractors: 她说最后两个星期过得最轻松。
她说自己在这家公司只工作了两个星期。
她说花了两周时间才成功找到新工作。
deepNotes: 说话框架是 she said，前面的完整直接引语是 said 所表达的内容；引语内部 The first two weeks 是主语，were 是系动词，the most difficult to live through 是表语。注意题目让你找外层引述框架。

roleExplanations.s: she 指 Zoe，是引语后 said 的主语；引语里的 The first two weeks 是引语内部的主语。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「said」。
roleExplanations.o: 整段直接引语作 said 的内容；不要只选择引语里的 the first two weeks。

grammarSupplements.text: The first two weeks were the most difficult to live through
grammarSupplements.explanation: 引语内部另有一套主谓表：The first two weeks / were / the most difficult。

studyUnits.question: 她说哪段时间最难熬？
studyUnits.explanation: 这是直接引语内部的主语。

studyUnits.question: 这段直接引语的系动词是什么？
studyUnits.explanation: were 对应主语 The first two weeks。

studyUnits.question: 这两个星期到底怎么样？
studyUnits.text: the most difficult to live through,
studyUnits.explanation: the most difficult to live through 说明最难熬，是引语内系动词 were 的表语。

sentences.sentence: "After everything I'd done for the company, they dismissed me by text!

targets.o: me

sentences.main: they dismissed me by text
sentences.analysis: 主干 they dismissed me；After everything ... 表示在她为公司付出之后的背景。I'd done for the company 是省略关系代词 that 的定语从句，修饰 everything，不能把 done 当作主句谓语。
sentences.meaning: “在我为公司做了那么多之后，他们竟然用短信就把我解雇了！
distractors: “因为我没为公司做任何事情，他们把我调去负责发短信！
“公司称赞了我过去的工作，并通过短信给我加薪！
“我发短信告知公司自己辞职，公司没有回应！
deepNotes: 主干 they dismissed me；After everything ... 表示在她为公司付出之后的背景。I'd done for the company 是省略关系代词 that 的定语从句，修饰 everything，不能把 done 当作主句谓语。

m.relation: 修饰句首背景中的 everything

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语是「they」。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「dismissed」。
roleExplanations.o: 主句宾语是「me」。若是完整宾语从句，应把整个从句选出来。
roleExplanations.m: I'd done for the company 修饰 everything，解释她之前为公司做过的全部事情；被修饰的不是 they 或 me。

grammarSupplements.text: After everything I'd done for the company,
grammarSupplements.explanation: 整个结构交代事情发生的背景，意思是“在我为公司做了这么多之后”。

studyUnits.question: 哪段话强调她此前为公司已经做了很多事？
studyUnits.text: After everything I'd done for the company,
studyUnits.explanation: After 引出事态发生的背景；I'd done for the company 修饰 everything。

studyUnits.question: 他们通过什么方式解雇了她？
studyUnits.explanation: by text 修饰 dismissed，表示通过短信解雇。

sentences.sentence: I was so angry and I just didn't feel like looking for another job.
sentences.main: I was so angry; I didn't feel like looking for another job.
sentences.analysis: 第一分句 I was so angry 是主系表结构。and 后的 I just didn't feel like looking for another job 是另一完整分句：didn't feel like 表示不想，looking for another job 是其后的动名词内容。两个 I 都指 Zoe，但每个分句各有自己的谓语。
sentences.meaning: 我非常生气，根本不想再找另一份工作。
distractors: 我因为找到另一份工作而高兴极了。
我虽然感到生气，却立即积极寻找另一份工作。
我生气是因为公司强迫我为别人介绍工作。
deepNotes: 第一分句 I was so angry 是主系表结构。and 后的 I just didn't feel like looking for another job 是另一完整分句：didn't feel like 表示不想，looking for another job 是其后的动名词内容。两个 I 都指 Zoe，但每个分句各有自己的谓语。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语是「I」。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「was」。

grammarSupplements.text: I just didn't feel like looking for another job.
grammarSupplements.explanation: and 后的主语 I 再次出现，didn't feel like 表示“不想”，这不是第一分句系动词 was 后的宾语。

studyUnits.question: 第一分句 I was 后面说明她情绪状态的是什么？
studyUnits.explanation: so angry 是描述 Zoe 非常生气的表语。

studyUnits.question: and 后面第二个完整分句的主语是什么？
studyUnits.explanation: 第二个 I 仍指 Zoe，但后面是不一样的谓语。

studyUnits.question: 第二分句表示她不想做某事的谓语是哪一段？
studyUnits.explanation: didn't feel like 表示不想做，是否定谓语组合。

studyUnits.question: Zoe 不想再做的具体事情是什么？
studyUnits.explanation: looking for another job 整体说明她不想做的事。

sentences.sentence: I hated everything about the city and my life."

targets.o: everything about the city and my life.

sentences.main: I hated everything about the city and my life.
sentences.analysis: 主干 I hated everything。everything 是宾语中心，about the city and my life 用来限定她讨厌的内容；它不是需要单独寻找的介词短语题。
sentences.meaning: “我讨厌这座城市和自己生活中的一切。”
distractors: “我仍然喜欢城市生活中的每一个方面。”
“我只是讨厌公司，但非常热爱伦敦。”
“我只讨厌自己的工作，对城市没有意见。”
deepNotes: 主干 I hated everything。everything 是宾语中心，about the city and my life 用来限定她讨厌的内容；它不是需要单独寻找的介词短语题。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语是「I」。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「hated」。
roleExplanations.o: everything 是 hated 的宾语中心；about the city and my life 进一步说明“关于城市和自己生活的一切”，圈宾语中心或完整宾语短语都可以。

studyUnits.question: 哪一部分说明她讨厌的是哪些方面的一切？
studyUnits.text: about the city and my life.
studyUnits.explanation: about the city and my life 修饰 everything，将讨厌的范围指向城市及过去生活。

sentences.sentence: Then, Zoe received an invitation from an old school friend, Kathy, to come and stay.

targets.o: an invitation

sentences.main: Zoe received
sentences.analysis: 主干 Zoe received an invitation。from an old school friend, Kathy 说明邀请来自谁；to come and stay 是邀请的具体内容。这些属于宾语的扩展信息，而不是独立小短语选择任务。
sentences.meaning: 后来，佐伊收到老同学凯茜的邀请，让她来住一段时间。
distractors: 随后，佐伊邀请老同学凯茜到伦敦长住。
佐伊收到一封学校寄来的工作录用通知。
凯茜拒绝了佐伊希望来农场居住的请求。
deepNotes: 主干 Zoe received an invitation。from an old school friend, Kathy 说明邀请来自谁；to come and stay 是邀请的具体内容。这些属于宾语的扩展信息，而不是独立小短语选择任务。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语是「Zoe」。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「received」。
roleExplanations.o: an invitation 是 received 的核心宾语，也认可带来源和内容修饰的完整名词短语。

grammarSupplements.text: to come and stay.
grammarSupplements.explanation: 说明邀请她去做什么：来并暂住。

o: an invitation from an old school friend, Kathy, to come and stay.

studyUnits.question: 哪段内容说明邀请来自谁？
studyUnits.text: from an old school friend, Kathy,
studyUnits.explanation: 修饰 invitation，交代邀请的来源；Kathy 与 old school friend 指同一个人。

studyUnits.question: 哪段内容说明 Kathy 邀 Zoe 去做什么？
studyUnits.explanation: 补充说明 invitation 的具体内容，即来住一段时间。

sentences.sentence: Kathy and her husband, Huw, had just bought a farm in north-west Wales.

targets.o: a farm

sentences.main: Kathy and her husband, Huw, had just bought
sentences.analysis: 主句是 Kathy and her husband had just bought a farm。Huw 是丈夫的同位语，补充其姓名；in north-west Wales 修饰 farm 的位置。
sentences.meaning: 凯茜和丈夫休刚刚在威尔士西北部买下了一座农场。
distractors: 凯茜和丈夫打算卖掉在伦敦的农场。
凯茜的丈夫休独自买下了威尔士东北部的公寓。
凯茜和休已经在农场生活了几十年。
deepNotes: 主句是 Kathy and her husband had just bought a farm。Huw 是丈夫的同位语，补充其姓名；in north-west Wales 修饰 farm 的位置。

roleExplanations.s: Kathy and her husband, Huw 是并列主语，Huw 为 husband 的同位语。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「had just bought」。
roleExplanations.o: a farm 是买下的对象；in north-west Wales 修饰这座农场，完整宾语短语也算对。

studyUnits.question: 哪一个名字说明 Kathy 的丈夫是谁？
studyUnits.explanation: Huw 与 her husband 指同一人，作同位语。

studyUnits.question: 哪段内容说明农场位于哪个地区？
studyUnits.explanation: 修饰 a farm，说明农场位置；重点是它修饰哪个名词。

sentences.sentence: Zoe jumped at the chance to spend a weekend away from London, and now, ten months later, she is still on the farm.
sentences.main: Zoe jumped at the chance; she is still on the farm.
sentences.analysis: 前半句 Zoe jumped at the chance 表示欣然接受机会。and 后 now, ten months later, she is still on the farm 是独立分句，主语从 Zoe 变成 she，谓语为 is；不要把 is 误标为 Zoe 的共享主语并列谓语。
sentences.meaning: 佐伊立刻抓住机会，离开伦敦去度周末；而如今，十个月过去了，她仍然待在农场。
distractors: 佐伊拒绝了邀请，直到十个月后才第一次去农场。
佐伊在伦敦度过周末后就再也没有去过农场。
佐伊在农场住了十个月后返回伦敦继续工作。
deepNotes: 前半句 Zoe jumped at the chance 表示欣然接受机会。and 后 now, ten months later, she is still on the farm 是独立分句，主语从 Zoe 变成 she，谓语为 is；不要把 is 误标为 Zoe 的共享主语并列谓语。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语是「Zoe」。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「jumped」。

grammarSupplements.text: she is still on the farm.
grammarSupplements.explanation: and 后的独立主句说明十个月后她仍留在农场，this is the unexpected outcome。

studyUnits.question: 她欣然抓住的机会具体是什么？
studyUnits.text: to spend a weekend away from London,
studyUnits.explanation: to spend ... 修饰 chance，说明这个机会就是离开伦敦过周末。

studyUnits.question: 哪段话说明时间过去了十个月？
studyUnits.explanation: 第二独立分句的时间背景，强调短暂访问已变成长住。

studyUnits.question: and 后第二个独立分句讲的是谁？
studyUnits.explanation: she 指 Zoe，后面的谓语是 is，而非 Zoe 在前半句的 jumped。

studyUnits.question: 这个分句的系动词是什么？
studyUnits.explanation: she is still on the farm：is 表示此时的状态。

studyUnits.question: 哪一部分说明她仍待在哪里？
studyUnits.explanation: is 后面的地点表语，说明她十个月后仍在农场。

sentences.sentence: "The moment I arrived at Kathy's farm, I loved it and I knew I wanted to stay," said Zoe.

targets.o: "The moment I arrived at Kathy's farm, I loved it and I knew I wanted to stay,"

sentences.main: Zoe said she loved the farm immediately and wanted to stay.
sentences.analysis: 外层引述主干 Zoe said，前面是完整直接引语。引语内 The moment I arrived ... 是时间从句；I loved it 和 I knew I wanted to stay 并列，两个 I 都是各自分句主语；I wanted to stay 是 knew 的宾语从句（省略 that）。
sentences.meaning: 佐伊说：“我一到凯茜的农场就爱上了这里，而且知道自己想留下来。”
distractors: 佐伊说自己一到农场便失望，而且从不想留下。
佐伊说她直到很久以后才知道凯茜有一座农场。
佐伊说自己喜欢伦敦，打算周末后马上回去。
deepNotes: 外层引述主干 Zoe said，前面是完整直接引语。引语内 The moment I arrived ... 是时间从句；I loved it 和 I knew I wanted to stay 并列，两个 I 都是各自分句主语；I wanted to stay 是 knew 的宾语从句（省略 that）。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语是「Zoe」。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「said」。
roleExplanations.o: 主句宾语是「"The moment I arrived at Kathy's farm, I loved it and I knew I wanted to stay,"」。若是完整宾语从句，应把整个从句选出来。

grammarSupplements.text: The moment I arrived at Kathy's farm,
grammarSupplements.explanation: The moment 相当于 as soon as，表示她一到农场，就产生了后面的感受。

grammarSupplements.text: I wanted to stay
grammarSupplements.explanation: 这是 knew 后省略 that 的宾语从句，说明她知道的事情。

studyUnits.question: 哪段话表示她一到农场，就发生了后面的事情？
studyUnits.text: The moment I arrived at Kathy's farm,
studyUnits.explanation: The moment 在这里引导时间从句，相当于 as soon as。

studyUnits.question: 引语中爱上农场的人是谁？
studyUnits.explanation: 这里第二次出现的 I 是 I loved it 的主语，指 Zoe。

studyUnits.question: 她一到农场就爱上了它，动词是什么？
studyUnits.explanation: loved 是 I loved it 的谓语。

sentences.analysis: Zoe 是共享主语；has been working（现在完成进行时）和 says 是两组并列谓语。第二组 says 后 she has no regrets 是省略 that 的宾语从句；第一组 working 是不及物用法，没有硬凑出普通宾语。

distractors: 她说农场生活非常轻松，从来不会累。
她说只有精神上觉得疲惫，身体反而轻松。
她说最艰难的是都市生活，农场毫无压力。
deepNotes: 报道框架 she says；前面的引语交代她的评价。引语内 It's a hard life 中 it 指农场生活，physically very tiring 补充说明这种生活身体上多么累，不能只凭 tiring 就断定她不喜欢乡村生活。

sentences.sentence: "In London I was stressed and often mentally exhausted.

sentences.meaning: “在伦敦时，我压力很大，而且经常感到精神疲惫。
distractors: “在伦敦时，我虽然劳累，但精神一直很放松。
“在伦敦时，我只是在身体上感到精疲力尽。
“我在伦敦从不焦虑，也没有精神上的压力。
deepNotes: 引语内 I was ... 属于主系表结构：I 是主语，was 是系动词；stressed 和 mentally exhausted 描述过去在伦敦的心理状态。注意 mentally（精神上）与下句 physically（身体上）构成对比。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语是「I」。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「was」。

studyUnits.question: 什么地方的生活让她压力大而精神疲惫？

studyUnits.question: 哪个词说明她经常感到疲惫？

studyUnits.question: 哪个词强调是精神上而非身体上的疲惫？
studyUnits.explanation: mentally 修饰 exhausted，和下一句 healthy tiredness 对比。

studyUnits.question: 哪一部分完整说明她当时的精神状态？
studyUnits.explanation: stressed 和 mentally exhausted 并列表语，说明她在伦敦的状态。

sentences.sentence: But this is a good, healthy tiredness.
sentences.main: this is a good, healthy tiredness.
sentences.analysis: this 指现在农场劳作后的疲惫；is 是系动词，后面的 a good, healthy tiredness 是表语名词短语。结合上一句可看出城乡两种疲惫的性质不同。

这种疲惫说明农场生活有害健康。

roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「is」。

studyUnits.question: 哪两个词修饰 tiredness，表明这是有益的疲劳？
studyUnits.explanation: good 和 healthy 一起修饰 tiredness；不是让学生从不同介词短语中猜答案。

studyUnits.question: is 后面哪个成分说明 this 是怎样的疲劳？
studyUnits.explanation: 完整表语说明这种疲劳是健康的。

sentences.sentence: Here, all I need to put me in a good mood is a hot bath and one of Kathy's wonderful dinners."

targets.s: all I need to put me in a good mood

“只有凯茜陪我回伦敦，我才会觉得愉快。”
“这里没有可以让我放松的事，我只需要工作。”

deepNotes: 主句 Zoe says。she has never felt bored on the farm 是省略 that 的宾语从句，整体表示 Zoe 说的内容；has never felt 是从句内部谓语，而不是主句谓语。

studyUnits.question: 宾语从句中的完整谓语动词是哪一段？

sentences.sentence: Kathy has been teaching her how to ride a horse and she has learnt to drive a tractor.

targets.o: how to ride a horse

凯茜禁止佐伊接触农场的马和拖拉机。

studyUnits.question: Zoe 后来学会开拖拉机，谓语是哪组词？

sentences.meaning: 从圣诞节以来，她一直帮忙照料母羊产羔。她说，看到小羊出生简直不可思议：“这是我经历过的最令人感动的事情之一。我现在再也不可能回到城市生活了。”
distractors: 圣诞节后她就不再参与农场工作，也从未见过小羊出生。
她觉得小羊出生令人难以忍受，因此决定立即回伦敦。
她说农场经历十分平淡，自己一直盼望返回城市。
deepNotes: 主干起始为 she has been helping with the lambing。破折号后 watching a lamb being born 作主语，is unbelievable 作系表；she says 插入说明这是佐伊的评价。引语中 It's one of the most moving experiences I've ever had 含省略 that 的定语从句 I've ever had，修饰 experiences；末尾 I could never go back to city life now 是她的直接表态。

roleExplanations.s: 句首 she 指 Zoe，主句谓语 has been helping；破折号后的 watching a lamb being born 是另一个分句的动名词主语。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是「has been helping」。

review.overview: Zoe Chambers 原本在伦敦事业顺利，却被短信解雇。好友 Kathy 邀她到威尔士农场暂住，结果 Zoe 发现劳动虽然辛苦，却带来了健康、充实和真切的感动，再也不想返回都市生活。

paragraphNotes.connection: 第70题关键是 physically tiring 与 good, healthy tiredness。

development: 第1段：伦敦生活表面成功 → 突然失业 → 生气失落。
第2段：受到老朋友邀请 → 短期访农场 → 决定留下。
第3段：伦敦精神透支与农场身体疲劳形成鲜明对照。
第4段：学新技能、接羔羊、获得满足 → 不愿返回城市。
keyGrammar: has been working / has been teaching / has been helping：现在完成进行时，表示从过去持续到现在。
Zoe says (that) she has no regrets：that 可省略的宾语从句，整体作 says 的宾语。
everything (that) I'd done ... / experiences (that) I've ever had：省略关系代词的定语从句，分别修饰 everything 与 experiences。
The moment I arrived ...：The moment 引导时间状语从句，相当于 as soon as。
all (that) I need ... is ...：主语中嵌有定语从句，系动词 is 后是表语，不应强行找宾语。
keyPhrases: dismiss someone by text：通过短信解雇某人
jump at the chance：欣然抓住机会
put someone in a good mood：使某人心情变好
physically tiring but rewarding：身体上劳累但值得
commonMistakes: 第68题问的是原先在伦敦时 Zoe 的自我感受，不能用后文的 meaningless 作答案。
第69题的“最重要原因”是突然失业，不是因为 Kathy 强行说服她。
第70题需区分伦敦的精神疲惫和农场的身体疲惫。
第71题概括人物遭遇与心态转变，不是把好友相助这个细节直接当主题。

sentences.sentence: A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds found that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money.

targets.s: A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds
targets.o: that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money.

sentences.main: A study found that most of them are ignorant.
sentences.analysis:
【主句主干】主句主语中心 A study（完整主语 A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds），谓语 found；found 后接 that 引导的完整宾语从句 that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money。
【主句定语】involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds 为现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰 study；其中 from all social backgrounds 修饰 teenagers，说明其社会背景。
【宾语从句内部】that 为连接词；most of them 为从句主语；are 为系动词；ignorant 为形容词表语，构成主系表；when it comes to money 为习惯表达，作方面/话题状语，限定从句内部的 ignorant。
【主句状语】主句本身没有独立的状语，不能把宾语从句中的 when it comes to money 误标成修饰 found 的主句状语。
【判题口径】主句主语选 A study 或完整主语均正确；宾语选 that most of them are ignorant 或完整宾语从句均正确。但分析完整结构时应补充后置定语和从句内部的状语。
sentences.meaning: 一项涉及来自各种社会背景的8500名青少年的研究发现，大多数人在涉及金钱问题时缺乏相关知识。
distractors: 一项针对8500名青少年的研究发现，无论家庭背景如何，大多数人都熟悉各种金钱问题。
这项研究只调查了来自富裕家庭的8500名青少年，发现他们普遍缺乏理财知识。
一项涉及8500名成年人的研究发现，青少年对金钱问题的了解普遍超过成年人。
deepNotes: 主句完整主语范围含 involving ... 的后置定语，但核心主语 A study 可以独立识别。主语中心与完整主语都算对。
involving 为现在分词而非主句谓语；不能因它位于 study 后便误认成另一个主句动作。
found 后面的 that 引导宾语从句；从句内 most of them are ignorant 是主系表，不是主句又出现了一套主谓。
when it comes to money 是从句内部的方面/话题状语，不是主句的时间状语；主句没有单独的状语。
完整宾语从句包含尾部的 when it comes to money；选 that most of them are ignorant 可用于识别其核心结构。

roleExplanations.s: 主句完整主语是 A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds；中心主语是 A study。后面 involving ... 为修饰 study 的现在分词后置定语，两种主语范围都接受。
roleExplanations.v: 主句谓语是 found（发现）；不要误将 involving 或宾语从句里的 are / comes 当成主句谓语。
roleExplanations.o: 主句宾语是 that 引导的完整宾语从句 that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money；其核心 most of them are ignorant 为主系表结构，when it comes to money 是从句内部的方面状语。

grammarSupplements.explanation: 整个 involving ... 是现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰主语中心词 study；其中 from all social backgrounds 修饰 teenagers。主句谓语只有 found。

grammarSupplements.explanation: 这是宾语从句内部的方面/话题状语，意思是‘谈到金钱时’。宾语从句的主干是 most of them（主语）+ are（系动词）+ ignorant（表语）；它不是主句 found 的状语。

sentences.main: The findings are particularly worrying.
sentences.analysis:
【主句】The findings 是主语，are 为系动词，particularly worrying 为形容词性表语，构成主系表。
【主语补充】the first in a series of reports ... money 是 findings 的同位语，说明这是系列报告中的第一份。that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money 修饰 NatWest，has started 为该定语从句谓语。
【原因状语从句】as this generation of young people is likely to be burdened with greater debts than any before 是修饰主句‘令人担忧’的原因从句；内部 this generation of young people 为主语，is likely 为系表结构，to be burdened ... 为不定式补充，其核心 to be burdened 是被动结构；than any before 省略重复名词，比较前代年轻人的债务。
【界限】主句没有宾语；研究项目属于定语从句，不能算成 are 的宾语。

【界限】主句没有宾语；研究项目属于定语从句，不能算成 are 的宾语。

roleExplanations.s: 主句主语 The findings（这些研究结果）；紧随其后的 the first ... 是同位语，不是另一个主句主语。
roleExplanations.v: are 是主句系动词，particularly worrying 为表语；不是‘are + 宾语’。

grammarSupplements.text: the first in a series of reports from NatWest that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money,
grammarSupplements.explanation: 这段是 findings 的同位语；其中 from NatWest 说明报告来源，that has started ... 为修饰 NatWest 的定语从句（that 作主语，has started 作谓语）。

grammarSupplements.text: particularly worrying
grammarSupplements.explanation: 主句 The findings are particularly worrying 是主系表结构。are 是系动词，particularly worrying 是表语；下文 as 原因状语从句解释为何令人担忧。

grammarSupplements.explanation: 这段不定式补充 likely 的内容。to be burdened 是被动结构；greater ... than any before 表示相较以往任何一代债务更重。从句主语是 this generation of young people，is likely 表示‘很可能’。

studyUnits.explanation: 整个部分是主语 The findings 的同位语，内部的 that 定语从句只在解析里说明，不另外拆题。

sentences.sentence: University tuition fees (学费) are currently capped at £3,000 annually, but this will be reviewed next year and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling.
sentences.main: University tuition fees are currently capped; this will be reviewed; and the Government is under enormous pressure.
sentences.analysis:
【并列分句①】University tuition fees (学费) 是主语，are currently capped 为被动谓语，at £3,000 表示学费上限，annually 表示每年。
【并列分句②】but this will be reviewed next year：this 是主语，指前文收费上限，will be reviewed 为被动谓语，next year 为时间状语。
【并列分句③】and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling：the Government 为主语，is 为系动词，under enormous pressure 为介词短语作表语；to raise the ceiling 为不定式后置修饰 pressure，交代压力要求的行动；the ceiling 指费用上限。
【易错点】三组主语分别是 tuition fees / this / the Government。but 和 and 连接的是三个分句，不能误判为相同主语的并列谓语；这里没有主句的直接宾语。
sentences.meaning: 大学学费目前的年度上限是3000英镑，不过这项限制将于明年重新审议，而政府正面临要求提高上限的巨大压力。
distractors: 英国大学学费目前每年最低为3000英镑，政府计划在明年取消这一最低收费标准。
大学学费的年度上限已经提高到3000英镑以上，政府正面临要求降低学费的巨大压力。
大学学费的上限目前是每年3000英镑，政府已经决定明年不再审议或调整这一限制。
deepNotes: 【并列分句①】University tuition fees (学费) 是主语，are currently capped 为被动谓语，at £3,000 表示学费上限，annually 表示每年。
【并列分句②】but this will be reviewed next year：this 是主语，指前文收费上限，will be reviewed 为被动谓语，next year 为时间状语。

【并列分句③】and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling：the Government 为主语，is 为系动词，under enormous pressure 为介词短语作表语；to raise the ceiling 为不定式后置修饰 pressure，交代压力要求的行动；the ceiling 指费用上限。
【易错点】三组主语分别是 tuition fees / this / the Government。but 和 and 连接的是三个分句，不能误判为相同主语的并列谓语；这里没有主句的直接宾语。

roleExplanations.s: 第一分句的完整主语 University tuition fees (学费)；tuition 与 University 均修饰核心 fees。
roleExplanations.v: 第一分句 are currently capped 为被动谓语，currently 是时间副词；at £3,000 annually 说明上限金额及年计口径。

grammarSupplements.kind: 第一分句·金额与频率状语
grammarSupplements.text: at £3,000 annually,
grammarSupplements.explanation: at £3,000 表示学费最高金额，annually 为‘每年’的频率状语。第一分句主语 University tuition fees，谓语 are currently capped。

grammarSupplements.explanation: 第二分句的主语 this 指学费上限，will be reviewed 是被动谓语，next year 是时间状语。这里不是 fees 的并列谓语。

grammarSupplements.explanation: 第三分句主语 the Government，系动词 is，under enormous pressure 为表语；to raise the ceiling 修饰 pressure，说明所承受压力的具体内容。三个并列分句各有自己的主语。

sentences.sentence: In the research, the teenagers were presented with the terms of four different loans but 76 per cent failed to identify the cheapest.
sentences.main: The teenagers were presented with loan terms, but 76 per cent failed to identify the cheapest.
sentences.analysis:
【前置状语】In the research 为介词短语作范围/背景状语，说明研究场景。
【并列分句①】the teenagers（主语）+ were presented（被动谓语）+ with the terms of four different loans（介词补足语）；意思是向青少年提供四种贷款条款。of four different loans 修饰 terms。
【并列分句②】but 76 per cent（主语，意指研究中的76%青少年）+ failed（谓语）+ to identify the cheapest（不定式补足语）；the cheapest 是省略 loan 的名词化最高级，作 identify 的宾语。
【易错】but 后是不同主语的新分句，不是 teenagers 的第二个共用主语谓语；前句的 with ... 也不是额外的主句直接宾语。

研究显示，76%的青少年无法在四种贷款中找出利率最高的那一种。
研究发现，青少年只获得一种贷款方案的条款，因此无法比较四种贷款的成本。
deepNotes: 【前置状语】In the research 为介词短语作范围/背景状语，说明研究场景。
【并列分句①】the teenagers（主语）+ were presented（被动谓语）+ with the terms of four different loans（介词补足语）；意思是向青少年提供四种贷款条款。of four different loans 修饰 terms。
【并列分句②】but 76 per cent（主语，意指研究中的76%青少年）+ failed（谓语）+ to identify the cheapest（不定式补足语）；the cheapest 是省略 loan 的名词化最高级，作 identify 的宾语。
【易错】but 后是不同主语的新分句，不是 teenagers 的第二个共用主语谓语；前句的 with ... 也不是额外的主句直接宾语。

sentences.main: Stephen Moir said ...
sentences.analysis:
【外层主句】Stephen Moir 是主语；said 是谓语；其后整段引号内的话是直接引语，作为 said 说出的内容。
【同位语与定语】head of community investment at the Royal Bank of Scotland Group which owns NatWest 是人物身份同位语，说明 Stephen Moir 的职位；which owns NatWest 定语从句修饰 Royal Bank of Scotland Group，该从句主语 which、谓语 owns、宾语 NatWest。
【直接引语的关联比较】两个程度条件形成一个结论：The more exposed young people are to financial issues（青少年接触金融问题越多）；and the younger they become aware of them（越早意识到）；the more likely they are to become responsible, forward-planning adults ...（就越可能成长为负责且有规划的成年人）。它们并非外层 Stephen Moir 的并列谓语。
【引语内部】第一比较分句的主语 young people、系动词 are、前置表语 more exposed；第二分句的主语 they、系动词 become、表语 aware，the younger 表示认知发生得更早；结果分句主语 they、系动词 are、表语 more likely，to become ... 为补足语。
【嵌套定语从句】who manage their finances confidently and effectively 修饰 adults；其主语 who、谓语 manage、宾语 their finances，confidently and effectively 为并列方式状语。

【宾语】new lessons in how to manage debts 是完整宾语，中心词 lessons，new 前置修饰它；只选 new lessons 作为宾语中心名词短语也可以判对。
【后置定语】in how to manage debts 是介词短语修饰 lessons，说明课程的内容；介词 in 后的 how to manage debts 是疑问词 how + 不定式构成的结构（如何管理债务），manage 的宾语为 debts。
【不要误判】in how ... 不属于独立主句状语，也没有新的有限谓语或独立从句。

sentences.main: Nikki Fairweather said ... but admitted ...
sentences.analysis:
【主句】Nikki Fairweather 为共同主语；said（谓语①）和 admitted（谓语②）由 but 连接，是同一主语的并列谓语，不是两个不同主语的独立分句；每个谓语各支配自己的 that 宾语从句。
【主语补充】aged 15 from St Helens 后置补充 Nikki 的年龄与来自哪里；aged 15 表年龄的过去分词短语，from St Helens 表来源，不能误认为谓语。
【宾语从句①】that she had benefited from lessons on personal finance：she 为主语，had benefited 是过去完成时谓语，from lessons on personal finance 为动词 benefited 的介词补足语；on personal finance 修饰 lessons，说明理财课程主题。
【宾语从句②】that she still had a lot to learn about money：she 为主语，had 为谓语，a lot to learn about money 为宾语；still 为副词状语，to learn about money 是不定式作后置定语修饰 a lot，about money 补充 learn 所涉及的内容。
【易错】said 与 admitted 都由 Nikki 发出，不能把 she had benefited 或 she still had 误认成主句的并列谓语；but 不连接两个 that 宾语从句，而是连接两组‘谓语 + 宾语从句’。

【宾语从句②】that she still had a lot to learn about money：she 为主语，had 为谓语，a lot to learn about money 为宾语；still 为副词状语，to learn about money 是不定式作后置定语修饰 a lot，about money 补充 learn 所涉及的内容。

sentences.sentence: The first is to promote the dramatic success of Malawi, a country in southern Africa, which three years ago established a special fund to help its farmers get fertilizer and seeds with high productivity.

targets.p: to promote the dramatic success of Malawi

sentences.main: The first is to promote the dramatic success of Malawi.
sentences.analysis: 【第一层：主系表】The first 是主语，is 为系动词，to promote the dramatic success of Malawi 是不定式表语。整句不是只到 Malawi 就结束。【第二层：同位语】a country in southern Africa 补充说明 Malawi 是一个位于非洲南部的国家。【第三层：定语从句】which three years ago established a special fund ... 修饰 Malawi；which 在从句中作主语，established 是谓语，a special fund 是宾语，three years ago 是时间状语。【第四层：不定式目的状语】to help its farmers get fertilizer and seeds with high productivity 说明基金的用途；help sb. do sth. 中 farmers 是宾语，get 是省略 to 的不定式，fertilizer and seeds 是并列宾语；with high productivity 结合语义修饰 seeds。【注意】训练只额外圈选这三个有意义的整块，不在每一层内部反复拆成单词题。
sentences.meaning: 第一步是推广非洲南部马拉维的成功经验：三年前该国设立专项基金，帮助农民获得化肥和高产种子。
distractors: 第一步是要求南部非洲国家停止农业补贴和粮食生产。
马拉维政府三年前禁止农民使用化肥和优质种子。
作者认为第一步应从马拉维大量进口全部粮食。
deepNotes: 整句四层：①主句 The first / is / to promote the dramatic success of Malawi；②Malawi 的同位语 a country in southern Africa；③修饰 Malawi 的 which 定语从句（which / established / a special fund）；④基金设立的目的 to help ...。
which 指代 Malawi，不能误指 success；三年前设立基金的是马拉维，而不是 the success。
get fertilizer and seeds with high productivity 表示让农民获得化肥和高产种子；with high productivity 应结合语义理解为高产种子的特征。

roleExplanations.s: The first（第一步）是主句主语；这里不是 Malawi，因为 Malawi 出现在不定式表语里。
roleExplanations.v: is 是主句的系动词。不要把后面定语从句的 established 当成主句的第二个谓语。
roleExplanations.p: to promote the dramatic success of Malawi 是不定式短语作表语，说明第一步要做什么；其后还接同位语、定语从句和基金目的结构，需要继续分析。

questionSets.title: 2008年上海秋考英语 · 阅读 B · 原卷68—71题
questionSets.source: 2008年上海秋考英语 · 阅读理解 B（用户提供题图，参考解析卷与历年答案复核）
questionSets.intro: 共4道原卷阅读理解单选题。先独立作答并提交，之后查看标准参考答案、原文定位和解题分析。
questionSets.passageText:
Zoe Chambers was a successful PR (Public Relations) consultant and life was going well — she had a great job, a beautiful flat and a busy social life in London. Then one evening in June last year, she received a text message telling her she was out of work. "The first two weeks were the most difficult to live through," she said. "After everything I'd done for the company, they dismissed me by text! I was so angry and I just didn't feel like looking for another job. I hated everything about the city and my life."

Then, Zoe received an invitation from an old school friend, Kathy, to come and stay. Kathy and her husband, Huw, had just bought a farm in north-west Wales. Zoe jumped at the chance to spend a weekend away from London, and now, ten months later, she is still on the farm. "The moment I arrived at Kathy's farm, I loved it and I knew I wanted to stay," said Zoe. "Everything about my past life suddenly seemed meaningless."

Zoe has been working on the farm since October of last year and says she has no regrets. "It's a hard life, physically very tiring," she says. "In London I was stressed and often mentally exhausted. But this is a good, healthy tiredness. Here, all I need to put me in a good mood is a hot bath and one of Kathy's wonderful dinners."

Zoe says she has never felt bored on the farm. Every day brings a new experience. Kathy has been teaching her how to ride a horse and she has learnt to drive a tractor. Since Christmas, she has been helping with the lambing — watching a lamb being born is unbelievable, she says, "It's one of the most moving experiences I've ever had. I could never go back to city life now."

questions.stem: When working as a PR consultant in London, Zoe thought she lived a______ life.
options: satisfying
tough
meaningless
boring
questions.evidence: Zoe Chambers was a successful PR (Public Relations) consultant and life was going well — she had a great job, a beautiful flat and a busy social life in London.
questions.explanation: 第1段说她当时职业成功，工作、公寓和社交生活都很好，说明她过去认为伦敦生活令人满意。第2段到农场后才觉得“过去的生活毫无意义”，要区分前后态度，选 A。

questions.stem: The most important reason why Zoe went to visit Kathy's farm is that______.
options: Zoe lost her job as a PR consultant
Kathy persuaded her to do so
Zoe got tired of the city life
Zoe loved Wales more than London
questions.evidence: she received a text message telling her she was out of work. ... Zoe received an invitation from an old school friend, Kathy, to come and stay.
questions.explanation: 先发生的是 Zoe 突然被解雇，随后老朋友邀请她去农场暂住。失业才是此次生活转折的主要起因；Kathy 是邀请她，并没有文中所说的“说服”，选 A。

questions.stem: How does Zoe feel about the country life according to the passage?
options: Tiresome and troublesome.
Romantic and peaceful
Mentally exhausting but healthy
Physically tiring but rewarding.
questions.evidence: "It's a hard life, physically very tiring," she says. ... "But this is a good, healthy tiredness." ... "It's one of the most moving experiences I've ever had."
questions.explanation: 她明确说农场劳作让身体非常疲惫（physically very tiring），但这是健康的疲惫，且有许多感动、充实的新体验，所以是“身体累但值得”，选 D；C 把精神疲惫与农场生活混淆。

questions.stem: Which of the following is closest to the main idea of the passage?
options: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
Where there is a will, there is a way.
A misfortune may turn out a blessing.
Kill two birds with one stone.
questions.evidence: she received a text message telling her she was out of work. ... "Everything about my past life suddenly seemed meaningless." ... "I could never go back to city life now."
questions.explanation: 被解雇原本是不幸，却促成了 Zoe 在乡村找到更满意的生活，是“塞翁失马，焉知非福”，选 C。A 强调友谊但不是故事核心；B 强调意志；D 指一举两得。

questionSets.passageText:
A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds found that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money. The findings, the first in a series of reports from NatWest that has started a five-year research project into teenagers and money, are particularly worrying as this generation of young people is likely to be burdened with greater debts than any before.

University tuition fees (学费) are currently capped at £3,000 annually, but this will be reviewed next year and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling.

In the research, the teenagers were presented with the terms of four different loans but 76 per cent failed to identify the cheapest. The young people also predicted that they would be earning on average £31,000 by the age of 25, although the average salary for those aged 22 to 29 is just £17,815. The teenagers expected to be in debt when they finished university or training, although half said that they assumed the debts would be less than £10,000. Average debts for graduates are £12,363.

Stephen Moir, head of community investment at the Royal Bank of Scotland Group which owns NatWest, said, "The more exposed young people are to financial issues, and the younger they become aware of them, the more likely they are to become responsible, forward-planning adults who manage their finances confidently and effectively."

Ministers are deeply concerned about the financial pressures on teenagers and young people because of student loans and rising housing costs. They have just introduced new lessons in how to manage debts. Nikki Fairweather, aged 15 from St Helens, said that she had benefited from lessons on personal finance, but admitted that she still had a lot to learn about money.

questions.stem: Which of the following can be found from the five-year research project?
options: Students understand personal finances differently.
University tuition fees in England have been rising.
Teenagers tend to overestimate their future earnings.
The students' payback ability has become a major issue.
questions.evidence: The young people also predicted that they would be earning on average £31,000 by the age of 25, although the average salary for those aged 22 to 29 is just £17,815.
questions.explanation: 青少年预期收入£31,000，现实平均收入只有£17,815，说明高估未来收入。B项错误地把可能提高学费上限当作已经持续上涨，选C。

questions.stem: The phrase "to raise the ceiling" in paragraph 2 probably means "_______".
options: to raise the student loans
to improve the school facilities
to increase the upper limit of the tuition
to lift the school building roofs
questions.evidence: University tuition fees (学费) are currently capped at £3,000 annually, but this will be reviewed next year and the Government is under enormous pressure to raise the ceiling.
questions.explanation: capped at £3,000 annually 表示学费有最高限额，因此 raise the ceiling 是提高学费上限，不是提高屋顶，选C。

options: are too young to be exposed to financial issues
should learn to manage their finances well
should maintain a positive attitude when facing loans
benefit a lot from lessons on personal finance
questions.evidence: The more exposed young people are to financial issues, and the younger they become aware of them, the more likely they are to become responsible, forward-planning adults who manage their finances confidently and effectively.
questions.explanation: Stephen Moir 认为年轻人应尽早接触理财知识，以便有效管理财务，选B。D是Nikki的个人经历。

questions.stem: What can we learn from the passage?
options: Many British teenagers do not know money matters well
Teenagers in Britain are heavily burdened with debts.
Financial planning is a required course at college.
Young people should become responsible adults.
questions.evidence: A study involving 8,500 teenagers from all social backgrounds found that most of them are ignorant when it comes to money.
questions.explanation: 调查发现大多数英国青少年缺乏金钱知识，后文贷款、收入及债务数据进一步证实，选A。B混淆当前与未来，C把新开课程误作大学必修。

questionSets.passageText: The world economy has run into a brick wall. Despite countless warnings in recent years about the need to address a potential hunger crisis in poor countries and an energy crisis worldwide, world leaders failed to think ahead. The result is a global food crisis. Wheat, corn and rice prices have more than doubled in the past two years. And oil prices have increased more than three times since the start of 2004. These food-price increases, combined with increasing energy costs, will slow if not stop economic growth in many parts of the world and will even affect political stability. Practical solutions to these problems do exist, but we'll have to start thinking ahead and acting globally. Here are three steps to ease the current food crisis and avoid the potential for a global crisis. The first is to promote the dramatic success of Malawi, a country in southern Africa, which three years ago established a special fund to help its farmers get fertilizer and seeds with high productivity. Malawi’s harvest doubled after just one year. An international fund based on the Malawi model would cost a mere $10 per person annually in the rich world, or $10 billion altogether. Second, the U.S. and Europe should abandon their policies of paying partly for the change of food into biofuels. The U.S. government gives farmers a taxpayer-financed payment of 51 cents per gallon of ethanol (乙醇) changed from corn. There may be a case for biofuels produced on lands that do not produce foods — tree crops, grasses and wood products — but there's no case for the government to pay to put the world's dinner into the gas tank. Third, we urgently need to weather-proof the world's crops as soon and as effectively as possible. For a poor farmer, sometimes something as simple as a farm pond — which collects rainwater to be used in dry weather — can make the difference between a good harvest and a bad one. The world has already committed to establishing a Climate Adaptation Fund to help poor regions climate-proof vital economic activities such as food production and health care but has not yet acted upon the promise.

questions.stem: An international fund based on the Malawi model would______.
options: cost each of the developed countries $10 billion per year
aim to double the harvest in southern African countries In a year
decrease the food prices as well as the energy prices
give poor farmers access to fertilizer and highly productive seeds
questions.evidence: The first is to promote the dramatic success of Malawi ... a special fund to help its farmers get fertilizer and seeds with high productivity.
questions.explanation: 马拉维模式利用专项基金帮助农民获得化肥和高产种子；国际基金意在推广这种方式。$10 billion 是基金合计规模，不是每个国家独立支付。选D。
questions.context: 第一项方案：马拉维模式

questions.stem: With the second step, the author expresses the idea that ______.
options: it is not wise to change food crops into gas
it is misleading to put tree crops into the gas tank
we should get alternative forms of fuel in any way
biofuels should be developed on a large scale
questions.evidence: the U.S. and Europe should abandon their policies of paying partly for the change of food into biofuels.
questions.explanation: 作者反对补贴鼓励粮食作物转燃料，认为这种做法不明智，但并未反对非粮来源的生物燃料。选A。
questions.context: 第二项方案：放弃粮食燃料补贴

questions.stem: Which of the following is true according to the passage?
options: A rain-collecting pond is a simple safeguard against dry weal
A Climate Adaptation Fund has been established to help poor
The world has made a serious promise to build farm ponds.
It makes a great difference whether we develop wood products or not.
questions.evidence: something as simple as a farm pond — which collects rainwater to be used in dry weather — can make the difference between a good harvest and a bad one.
questions.explanation: 原文说简单的蓄水池能收集雨水、供干旱天气使用，因此A正确。B说基金已建立，与文章‘has not yet acted upon the promise’矛盾；C混淆水池与基金承诺；D不是文中强调的观点。注意原卷转录A项结尾 dry weal 和B项末尾 help poor 均明显残缺，这里按用户提供的选项原样保留，未擅自补写。
questions.context: 第三项方案：防旱与适应气候

questions.stem: In the passage, the author calls on us to______.
options: slow down but not to stop economic.
develop tree crops, grasses and wood products
achieve economic growth and political stability
act now so as to relieve the global food shortage
questions.evidence: Practical solutions to these problems do exist, but we'll have to start thinking ahead and acting globally.
questions.explanation: 作者指出全球粮食危机且列出三项对策，最后批评国际社会虽然承诺建基金但尚未付诸行动，因此呼吁马上行动缓解粮食短缺。选D。
